description: This file declares the CloudStoreImplementation class which implements the IStore2 interface for the WPEFramework plugin. It provides methods for registering notifications, setting and getting values, and deleting keys or namespaces, primarily wrapping calls to an internal IStore2 pointer.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: A class implementing the IStore2 interface for cloud storage operations within the WPEFramework plugin, with methods for managing store values and notifications.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback with the store if the internal store pointer is initialized.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback from the store if the internal store pointer is initialized.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the store for a specified namespace and key, within the ACCOUNT scope.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and its TTL from the store for a specified namespace and key, within the ACCOUNT scope.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the store within the ACCOUNT scope.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from the store within the ACCOUNT scope.
